name: Bitstream Font Fusion (T2K font engine)
version: unknown (no version or vendor string in the image)
license: proprietary (Bitstream Inc., now Monotype); not open source
evidence: Lane OC, 2026-10-27. The T2K API shape: every entry takes a trailing int *errCode; errors are 10000-based (0x2718 = 10008, the memory handler's allocation failure) and raised by setjmp/longjmp through the memory handler (FF_FindFontTypeFromStream 0x91dc8d calls _setjmp3 on [in+0x22c]+0x10). tsi_NewMemhandler 0x9116c7 allocates a 0xb0-byte handler stamped 0xab1500ff / 0xaa005501 / 0xa5a55a5a with a 501-entry block table. The font file reader (cGZFont's 0x90d6f7) runs the T2K open sequence: tsi_NewMemhandler, New_NonRamInputStream 0x911a54 (mem, file, read callback 0x90e340, length), FF_FindFontTypeFromStream (1 PFB, 2 TrueType, 7 / 0x16 other kinds), ExtractPureT1FromPCType1 0x91359f + New_InputStream3 0x9119be + Delete_InputStream 0x91180d for PFB, New_sfntClass 0x9199cb (7 args), NewT2K 0x91be9a. Strings: the Type 1 keyword set 0xe52d78..0xe52eac ('currentfile eexec' tail, '/FontMatrix ', '/WeightVector', '/BlueValues', '/em ', '/ascent ', '/descent ', 'RD ', '-| ', '/lenIV ': T2K's t1.c keywords, with trailing spaces; FreeType uses a keyword table without slashes), the CFF standard strings (0xe51c88.., '001.000'..'Semibold') and a TrueType bytecode interpreter jump table filled in code (0x928f18..0x9292ed). Not FreeType: no FT_ strings, FreeType returns FT_Error rather than writing an errCode out-parameter, and has no tsi memory handler.
notes: 18 entry points, all called only from cGZFont (0x90a7db..0x90eb7b) and its font file reader: 0x9115c0, 0x9116c7, 0x91180d, 0x9119be, 0x911a54, 0x91359f, 0x9198e1, 0x9199cb, 0x91bcf2, 0x91bdc8, 0x91be55, 0x91be9a, 0x91c04e, 0x91c300, 0x91c8ba, 0x91c9a8, 0x91da2f, 0x91dc8d. Replaced (lane OJ, 2026-10-28) by FreeType 2.14.3 behind a shim with Font Fusion's call shapes and object layouts (src/font/), hooked at the 18 entry points; cGZFont calls the shim. docs/verification.md, "Third-party library replaced".
